name: CleanShot X
tagline: Capture screenshots and recordings, mark up details, and share them without breaking your workflow.
description:
CleanShot X is a Mac screen-capture tool that replaces the built-in screenshot workflow with capture, annotation, recording, sharing, and reference tools in one app. The key difference is its quick-access overlay: after a capture, you can save, copy, drag, edit, pin, or upload it without first hunting for a file.

It is useful for bug reports, product feedback, documentation, demonstrations, and social images. Capture a region or scrolling content, mark the important part, then send the image or recording where it needs to go while the context is still fresh.

## Features

- Capture normal, timed, and scrolling screenshots, including scrollable content in any app.
- Annotate captures, recognize and copy text on-device with OCR, and apply presentation backgrounds to a screenshot.
- Record the screen to video or optimized GIF with microphone and macOS audio, webcam, click and keystroke highlights, notification hiding, and trimming.
- Pin a screenshot above other windows as a resizable, translucent reference.
- Hide Desktop icons during capture or screen sharing, and automatically scale Retina screenshots when needed.
- Share through the quick-access overlay, optionally upload to CleanShot Cloud, and use custom domains, branding, or team controls where the selected Cloud plan supports them.

## Where it fits

CleanShot X is for people who capture and communicate visual information daily and want fewer steps between seeing something and sending a clear explanation. It can replace several small screenshot, OCR, GIF, and annotation utilities.

The optional Cloud account is not required, but it changes where shared material lives. A simpler built-in tool may be enough for occasional captures, while ScreenFloat may suit a workflow centered on persistent visual references.

## Privacy and requirements

CleanShot requires macOS 13 or later and needs Screen Recording permission; microphone, camera, or Accessibility access is needed only for features that use them. Captures can remain local, while CleanShot Cloud receives files that the user chooses to upload. Cloud use is optional for the Mac app, and sensitive desktop items should be hidden or excluded before recording.

## Pricing

CleanShot X costs $35 for a Basic license; Pro costs $10 per user per month when billed annually.
